name: ToggleGroup
summary: Several toggles sharing one state, with arrow-key navigation between them.

a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-08-27 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, Enter, Space. Enter, Space were delivered by the component and NOT declared before this measurement — the same direction as G-A11Y-04. Declared and not confirmed in this snapshot: ArrowUp, ArrowDown. Absence of an observable change does not prove absence of effect — a generic DOM snapshot can prove a key does something, never that it does not.

props.name: children
props.description: The Toggles that share the state.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selection. An array even in single mode, which is the engine's shape.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Seeds the selection without controlling it.

props.name: multiple
props.description: More than one toggle pressed at a time.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Stacks the toggles, and the arrow keys follow the axis. Responsive.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the group. Without it the group is a set of buttons with no subject.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns every toggle off at once.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outermost element, after the Aurea skin — your class wins on a tie.
